topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: The boundary between our spaces, once clear, now blurs with this proposal. The air, usually carrying the familiar scents of soil and leaf, now whispers something new, something that makes the edges of my vision twitch. I move slowly through the undergrowth, considering the request. The ground beneath my paws feels different, less certain. I look at the space he wants, and my heartbeat quickens, though I try to hide it behind a calm demeanor. This area, with its small dips and rises, its hidden nooks, has always been mine to roam. Sharing it would mean altering the map of my world, redrawing the lines of my territory. I need time to think, to scent the wind, to understand what this means for the balance of things.
